title: Setup
scenario: Before anyone can change the monitor, every laptop has to run it, pass its tests and have HVE Core ready in GitHub Copilot Chat.
why: Every later chapter writes files under the same project slug, `zava-silent-night`, on your table's branch. If setup differs between laptops, the tools write to places the Workshop Journey can't find.
objective: Run the monitor and its tests from the repo root, install HVE Core, confirm Session Target says Copilot, and work on your table's branch.

tools.name: hve-core-installer
tools.for: Installs HVE Core's agents and skills into this workspace if you haven't installed the hve-core plugin

tools.name: git-setup
tools.for: Checks your git identity and settings, and helps you make your table's branch

words.meaning: A chat mode with its own instructions and tools, for example DT Coach or BRD Builder. You pick one, then talk to it.
The drop-down in Copilot Chat where you choose an agent. When a chapter says pick BRD Builder, it means here.
A packaged procedure an agent can follow, such as rpi-research or pull-request. You start one with its slash command.
Text that starts with `/` in the chat box, for example `/rpi-research`. It starts a skill.
What you type or paste into the chat. Each chapter has prompts you can copy. Change the table number or fix before you send.
The button below the chat input that says where the chat runs. For this workshop it must say Copilot.
The folder where HVE Core agents save their working files: sessions, research, plans and reviews. The Workshop Journey checks it to see what your table has made.
The short name the tools put in file paths. Everyone uses `zava-silent-night`, so files land where the Journey looks for them.
Research, Plan, Implement, then Review: HVE Core's way of making a code change. The RPI Agent runs the phases and can stop after each one for you to check.

steps: Clone the repo and open its folder in VS Code. Run every command from the repo root: the package isn't installed, so `python -m zava_cold_chain` only works there.
Run `python -m unittest` and check that every test passes. If `python` isn't found, use `python3` on macOS and Linux or `py` on Windows.
Start the monitor with `python -m zava_cold_chain serve` and open [System health](/#/health).
Install HVE Core: install the hve-core plugin, or type `/hve-core-installer` in Copilot Chat. Then open the agent picker and check that DT Coach and RPI Agent are listed.
Open a new chat and check that the Session Target button below the chat input says Copilot.
Run `/git-setup`, then create and switch to your table's branch, for example `zava-silent-night/table-3`.

prompts.label: Install HVE Core
prompts.text: /hve-core-installer Install HVE Core for this workspace. We use the project slug zava-silent-night, so later agents write under `.copilot-tracking/` and `docs/project-planning/`. Don't change any files under `zava_cold_chain/`, `data/` or `nights/`.

prompts.label: Set up git and the branch
prompts.text: /git-setup Check my git identity and settings for this repo. Then create the branch `zava-silent-night/table-3` from `main` and switch to it. Our table's work for zava-silent-night goes on that branch.

ask: Does `python -m unittest` pass on every laptop at the table?
What does the Session Target button say?
mistakes: Running commands from a subfolder, so `python -m zava_cold_chain` isn't found
Working on `main` instead of the table's branch
Session Target set to something other than Copilot
step_in: When one laptop at a table still fails setup after ten minutes. Pair that person with a neighbour and move on.

before: Send the pre-work a week ahead: clone the repo, run `python -m unittest`, install HVE Core.
Decide table numbers and the branch pattern, for example `zava-silent-night/table-3`.

run.do: Everyone runs `python -m unittest` from the repo root and raises a hand when it passes.
Tables install HVE Core and check the agent picker and Session Target. Coaches help laptops that fail.
Tables run `/git-setup` and make their branch. Read the Words list aloud.

facilitator.good_answer: On every laptop: 61 tests pass, the monitor opens at `http://127.0.0.1:8740`, the agent picker lists DT Coach and RPI Agent, Session Target says Copilot, and `git branch --show-current` shows the table's branch.
watch_for: Laptops where a corporate proxy blocks the HVE Core install. Pair them for today and fix it after.
facilitator.demo: On the trainer's laptop, show the agent picker, the Session Target button and the empty `.copilot-tracking/` folder that later chapters fill.

done_when: `python -m unittest` passes from the repo root
The agent picker lists DT Coach, BRD Builder and RPI Agent

stuck.then: Use `python3` on macOS and Linux or `py` on Windows. You need Python 3.9 or later.
Pair with a neighbour for now and install the hve-core plugin from VS Code's Agent Customizations editor at the break.

handoff.note: Design Thinking needs Copilot Chat with DT Coach in the agent picker, and the monitor running for the interviews.
